title: Claude Certified Architect – Foundations

meta.tagline: Blueprint-accurate mocks for the Claude Certified Architect – Foundations.
meta.description: 60 scenario questions across 5 domains in 120 minutes, scored 100 to 1,000 with a 720 pass mark: the same format as the official exam. Every option is explained.

delivery: delivered by Pearson VUE through the Anthropic Partner Academy
notes: The official exam is scenario-based: each form presents 4 of 6 published scenarios and asks questions grounded in them. Items in this bank are self-contained but are written inside those six scenario contexts (see `scenarios`).

The exam guide publishes domain weights only. Each domain's weight is split evenly across its task statements here so forms can be assembled per task; the split is an approximation, not an official figure.

scenarios.title: Customer Support Resolution Agent
scenarios.summary: An Agent SDK support agent handles returns, billing and account issues with MCP tools get_customer, lookup_order, process_refund and escalate_to_human, targeting 80%+ first-contact resolution.

scenarios.title: Code Generation with Claude Code
scenarios.summary: A development team standardises its Claude Code workflow with custom slash commands, CLAUDE.md files, and plan mode versus direct execution.

scenarios.title: Multi-Agent Research System
scenarios.summary: A coordinator delegates to web-search, document-analysis, synthesis and report subagents to produce cited research reports.

scenarios.title: Developer Productivity with Claude
scenarios.summary: Agent SDK tools explore codebases and legacy systems, generate boilerplate and automate chores using built-in Read/Write/Bash/Grep/Glob tools and MCP servers.

scenarios.title: Claude Code for Continuous Integration
scenarios.summary: Claude Code runs automated code review, test generation and PR feedback in CI, with prompts tuned to minimise false positives.

scenarios.title: Structured Data Extraction
scenarios.summary: An extraction pipeline turns unstructured documents into JSON-schema-validated records, handles edge cases and feeds downstream systems.

easy.label: Foundational
easy.blurb: Mostly single-concept scenarios. Good for a first pass through the blueprint.

standard.label: Exam-realistic
standard.blurb: The mix and timing of the real exam: mostly applied scenarios, some recall, some advanced tradeoffs.

hard.label: Challenging
hard.blurb: Over half the items are advanced or expert tradeoffs. Pass this and the real exam should feel comfortable.

expert.label: Expert
expert.blurb: Advanced and expert scenarios only, at full exam time. Built for candidates aiming well above the cut.

max.label: Max
max.blurb: Mostly expert items with 20% less time than the real exam. Score 1,000 here and nothing on the real exam should surprise you.
